name: Deep 2
source:
Main character is dormitory supervisor of a girls academy. He makes one room a punishment room where he sends girls suspected of impure heterosexual exchange. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是女子學院的宿舍管理員。他把其中一間房間改為懲罰室，把涉嫌「不純異性交往」的女孩送進去。
